title: LinkedInvetory
description: Link your Inventory and the Inventory of your friend
body:
🔗 Linked Inventory: One for All, All for One!

What if you shared everything? Linked Inventory redefines multiplayer survival by merging the inventories of every player on the server. What you pick up, your friends get. What you toss, they lose!
🌪️ The Concept

No more "Can you give me some wood?". With this Datapack, cooperation is forced to the extreme:

    Global Shared Inventory: Every player accesses the exact same inventory slots.

    Unified Hotbar: Coordinate in real-time as your hotbar shifts with your teammates' actions.

    Full Sync: Armor slots, off-hand items, and main inventory are completely linked across the server.

⚠️ The Challenge

    Resource Management: If one player crafts a diamond shovel, the diamonds are gone for everyone else!

    Inventory Chaos: You’ll need serious communication to keep your shared space organized.

    Perfect for: Co-op Speedruns, Hardcore challenges, or "Shared Inventory" YouTube series.
